steps.name: InMemorySink
steps.summary: Sinks/Logic/InMemorySink.cs — accumulates records for callers with no downstream consumer. Gives the Sinks concept its first Logic type.

steps.name: CountingSink
steps.summary: Sinks/Logic/CountingSink.cs — decorator observing records in flight and delegating, so the runner counts and collects while the engine publishes.

steps.name: Sink-less overload becomes sugar
steps.summary: The 4-arg ExecuteOperationAsync supplies an InMemorySink internally and returns its records in OperationResult.Records. No host call site breaks.

steps.name: Runner supplies sinks + delete the fork (S4+S5, one commit)
steps.summary: Route sink-routed stages to CountingSink(SinkProvider sink, captureNodes: NeedsRecordNodes) and control/poll/fan-out/merge-source stages to InMemorySink, AND move WorkflowRunner:493/:691/:715 off OperationResult.Records onto the sink, in one edit. Then remove the null default, make the sink non-nullable internally and delete the fork. Proven unsliceable: 58 failures when attempted separately.

steps.name: Split PublishStageRecordsAsync
steps.summary: Separate publication from counting and collecting; 9 parameters reduced per rule 5.

steps.name: Pin the new behaviour
steps.summary: Tests for sink lifecycle ordering, TotalPublishedRecords sourcing, and InMemorySink equivalence with the old sink-less path.

steps.name: Prove green and deterministic
steps.summary: At least 12 runs with trx capture; zero failures. A single green run proves nothing.

notes: A4 gate passed: ApplyCounts/CollectFromRecords need only a published count and per-page JsonNodes; a decorator suffices.
S1 InMemorySink and S2 CountingSink added; 697 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.
S3-S8 not started. S3-S5 must land together.
Code review run on the increment: 4 Majors, all fixed. Verifier deliberately deferred to S8 - eight of its criteria describe unstarted work.
D7 fixed (TotalRecords single meaning, matches its documentation); S3 done. 697/697.
